sql:
SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as unique_boats,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 287 AND fish_date_doy <= 301
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 100;

].copy()
